reviews.review_title: 🥹 honest review from a 2 year OG player
reviews.review_description:
🤝| My journey: I’ve been apart of the Memory Tag community for almost 2 years now. I’m a retired co-owner of the game. I’ve just recently asked to get my Retired Staff role taken in the Discord because I would like to try to comeback. 

⭐️| The review: This game has had many amazing updates. Not only that, the staff system throughout this community has my upmost respect. Staff are always helpful and supportive to fellow monkeys. The community isn’t toxic, and even if it is in some lobbies, fellow monkeys won’t hesitate to record their incident and post it in the reports channel of the Memory Tag Discord server.

Thank you very much for this amazing journey. I’m looking forward to continuing it today.

🟣 | The Discord: https://discord.gg/memorytag
